# Unused shape paragraph tab stops

Original XML fixture generated by `tools/shape_inactive_tabs_fixture.py` from our
own `shape-defaults.docx`. Eight shapes cover empty and visible text paragraphs,
each with left, center, right or decimal tab stops and dotted leaders, without
tab characters. No user artwork or fonts are redistributed.

`native.pdf` was exported from the reference application after confirming the exact source
path through its document object. `reference.json` records source/PDF
SHA-256 hashes, 40 raster color samples and glyph boxes. Regenerate using
`tools/record_shape_defaults_reference.py --inactive-tabs`.

All recorded color samples and glyph boxes exactly equal the unmodified
shape-defaults native reference. This agrees with ECMA-376 Part 1 §§17.3.1.37–38:
positional stops apply to tab characters. No reference/spec divergence was observed.
Bar tabs are not positional stops and remain rejected even without a character.

Browser checks cover native reference samples, body editing, retained shape XML, download,
reopen and exact OPC restoration after undo. Unit checks compare resolved
scenes and retain rejection of active custom tabs and bar tabs.
